newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea to seek 1,550 tonnes of aluminium ingot.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea to seek 1,550 tonnes of aluminium ingot.

text.p: South Korea's Office of Supply (OSROK) said on Friday it would invite tenders to buy 1,550 tonnes of aluminium ingot by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on April 25.
An OSROK official said the nation's procurement office would buy high-grade deliverable brand aluminium listed on the London Metal Exchange.
Delivery was set within three months after the contract would be made.
He said sellers would have to deliver the aluminium to the four OSROK warehouses in Inchon, Pusan, Taegu and Kwangju.
